Original fixture top level imports only standard library and retained perpetual_funding; SQL imports live only inside uncalled fixture/SQL methods.

enforcement.CPU: Parent binds CPU1 before Git preparation; sole target taskset CPU1; actual executable/hash/version/flags and affinity checked; no CPU fallback.
enforcement.audit: Fixed known source plus audit denying sqlite3.connect/process/network/signal and authority/proc opens; thread entry denied. Not an adversarial native-code OS sandbox.
enforcement.completion: Actual host exit/reap and both EOF, exact matching BEGIN/END and inner execution, native counts/no skip/failure, source/plan post-checks, timely TAIL plus separately observed caller actual outer exit0 are all required.
enforcement.exception_cleanup: Only the newly spawned timeout child is waited/reaped. Exceptions close owned pipes, attempt bounded own-child wait and retain actual unknown exit/reap; never classify an incomplete child as PASS.
enforcement.first_failure: Incomplete/timeout/source drift/raw failure stays UNKNOWN or actual FAIL; no retry or implicit fallback to all six methods.
enforcement.logical_output: Parent known control writes reserve 8MiB minus1MiB child control minus32KiB raw; child known controls share1MiB, raw has32KiB. O_EXCL0600 writes inside fresh canonical0700 directories. This is logical byte accounting, not kernel quota.
enforcement.raw: Parent FD1/2 selector collector counts one shared32KiB before write, keeps512-byte trailer, never refunds short writes; overflow/short-write sticky125 UNKNOWN and no later payload. Native child/timeout/bootstrap output is inside the pipes.
enforcement.target_timeout: New owned /usr/bin/timeout --signal=KILL 10s owns only the new target interpreter; parent completion classification guard12 seconds.

method_scope.selector_enforcement: Plan list must equal fixed code tuple; no discover or SQL mode; only FundingArithmeticTests methods constructed.
method_scope.unloaded_runtime_inputs: Other61 source inputs are pinned, not imported as services.

static_actions: standard-library AST parsing of control, inline bootstrap and three target source declarations

timing_limits.Git_preparation: Read-only Git/source preparation is outside the target timer and must not be reported as business warmup or method throughput.
timing_limits.hard_boundary: The12-second guard classifies late parent reads/fsync; it does not interrupt blocked filesystem IO or prove OS termination. Actual caller outcome remains required.
timing_limits.inner_elapsed: Retained target load and selected methods only; excludes bootstrap/runtime metadata and preparation, not E2E latency.
timing_limits.parent_elapsed: Captured target/drain window is not the entire parent lifecycle; TAIL and caller observed actual outer exit/wall time must be retained separately.
